# GitHub Labels

This document describes the labels used in this repository.

## Type Labels

- `bug` — Something isn't working
- `enhancement` — New feature or request
- `documentation` — Documentation improvements

## Category Labels

- `infrastructure` — Build system, deployment, tooling
- `performance` — Performance improvements
- `accessibility` — Accessibility improvements
- `design-system` — Design system components
- `webgl` — Three.js, shaders, 3D graphics
- `video` — Video playback, media delivery
- `cloudflare` — Cloudflare Pages, R2, Workers

## Phase Labels

- `phase-1` — Foundation and infrastructure
- `phase-2` — Design system and global state
- `phase-3` — Hero section and manifest
- `phase-4` — Portfolio section
- `phase-5` — Contact form and footer
- `phase-6` — Animations and interactions
- `phase-7` — WebGL experiences
- `phase-8` — Optimization and testing
- `phase-9` — Launch preparation

## Status Labels

- `blocked` — Blocked by dependency or external factor
- `needs-review` — Needs code review
